programs.title: Bumm Bumm Bole
programs.desc: Pinu, a young boy, misplaces his sister, Rimzim's shoes at a vegetable shop. However, in fear of their parents, Pinu asks Rimzim to share his pair of shoes until their father can afford new ones.
